{{Quote|Mara thinks she knows where the Empire's cloning facility might be. We thought it would be worth sending her and a small team to check it out.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the '''Wayland insertion group''' was a team that was given the task to [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|shut down]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility at [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="TLC" />

{{Military-stub}}

==History==
Following the [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] of [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] by the order of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jak Bremen]] for a possible implication in an [[Raid on Coruscant (Thrawn Crisis)|Imperial raid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Jade revealed to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that she knew the location of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility. Skywalker agreed to liberate her in exchange for the coordinates of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] joined the insertion group, along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Using the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', the insertion group landed on the planet and trekked through the forests of Wayland to [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].<ref name="TLC" />

Nearly ten years after the destruction of Mount Tantiss, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Pollo Tipn]] mentioned Wayland insertion group in a preliminary report on the [[Thrawn campaign]] for [[Professor/Legends|professor]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]].<ref name="TTTS" />
